releaseNotes:
NextGenSoftware.OASIS.API.Providers.AzureCosmosDBOASIS v2.0.5

Connects the OASIS to Azure Cosmos DB -- Microsoft's globally distributed, multi-model database (document, key-value, graph, column) with 99.999% availability SLAs, single-digit millisecond latency, and automatic global replication. Stores OASIS holons and avatars with enterprise SLAs. Part of the OASIS HOT-Swappable Provider Architecture. Ecosystem: https://oasisomniverse.one
